ideas.title: Investigating the Impact of the Child Care Funding Freeze
ideas.description: This story would investigate the potential impact of the child care funding freeze on child care providers and families who rely on these funds.
ideas.angle: The human impact of the funding freeze
questions: How will the funding freeze affect child care providers?
What are the potential consequences for families who rely on these funds?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to highlight the human impact of the funding freeze and raise awareness about the importance of child care funding.
